parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 4 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which entries are sorted by creation time. Valid values:

- **asc** (default): ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **5 to 30**. Default value: **10**.
